subject: general
question: The title of the autobiography of Rassundari Devi is _______ .

options.text: Smritichitre∶ The Memoirs of a Spirited Wife

solution:
The correct answer is **__Amar Jibon.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rassundari Devi **wrote the autobiography 'Amar Jibon'.
 
• Amar Jibon was published in the year** 1876.**
 
• It is the autobiography of **Rassundri Devi.**
 
• Also, it is the **first autobiography** written by an** Indian woman.**
 
• This book describes the status of **women in Indian society.**
 
• It was published in **Bengali.**
 
• Amar Jibon was translated by **Enakshi Chatterjee.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lakshmi Bai Tilak (1868–1936)** was a Marathi writer, best-known for her memoir, **Smritichitre∶ The Memoirs of a Spirited Wife.**
 
• **Aalo Aandhari is the autobiography of Baby Halder,** a domestic worker who battled poverty, hardship, violence and after a lot of struggle finally managed to make a name for herself as a writer.
 
• **Raseedi Ticket is Amrita Pritam's autobiography**, which tells us how she felt distressed at the influence of hate.
